title: My Scenario
intro: The opening curtain text the players see.

acts.title: Rainy Night
acts.summary: Keeper reference: the investigators arrive at the village and find the church unlit.
acts.trigger: When the investigators enter the village
acts.description: You reach the village gate in the rain. The church is dark, and water drips somewhere in the bell tower.

options.success: You find a line of wet footprints in the door gap.
options.successClue: The old postmark came from Saltmarsh twenty years ago.

sideEvents.title: Side Scene: Water in the Bell Tower
sideEvents.trigger: When an investigator approaches the bell tower
sideEvents.description: The water stops. You hear someone counting upstairs.

options.failure: A stair breaks under your foot.
options.failureClue: A fresh claw mark runs along the handrail.

acts.title: The Cellar
acts.summary: The investigators enter the cellar and face the final choice.
acts.trigger: When the investigators open the cellar door
acts.description: A lamp burns deep in the cellar, though it should not.

options.success: The flame dies. Something in the dark exhales.
options.failure: The wick bursts into blue fire.
